def dt_format_to_regex(c_format):
    """
    Convert a C style datetime format string into a regular expression.
    Supported directives: %Y, %y, %m, %d, %H, %M, %S, %f, %z, %Z.
    """
    mapping = {
        '%Y': r'(?P<Y>\\d{4})',
        '%y': r'(?P<y>\\d{2})',
        '%m': r'(?P<m>\\d{1,2})',
        '%d': r'(?P<d>\\d{1,2})',
        '%H': r'(?P<H>\\d{1,2})',
        '%M': r'(?P<M>\\d{1,2})',
        '%S': r'(?P<S>\\d{1,2})',
        '%f': r'(?P<f>\\d+)',
        '%z': r'(?P<z>[+-]\\d{4}|[+-]\\d{2}:\\d{2})',
        '%Z': r'(?P<Z>[A-Z]+)',
    }
    regex = ''
    i = 0
    length = len(c_format)
    while i < length:
        c = c_format[i]
        if c == '%':
            if i+1 >= length:
                raise ValueError('Incomplete format directive at end')
            directive = c + c_format[i+1]

                i += 2
                continue
            else:
                raise NotImplementedError(f'Unsupported directive {directive}')
        else:

            i += 1
    return regex
